Class SegmentDrawing

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Geometry.SegmentDef

ShapeEngine.dll

Provides static methods for drawing line segments and collections of segments with various styles, thicknesses, and effects.

Remarks

This class contains extension methods for Segment and Segments to simplify drawing operations.
